text:
clare: Quick question — for the annual planning offsite next month, should we do longer deep-dive breakouts or keep more of the day as lightning review + async prework? Trying to finalize facilitator cadence today.

ajay: leaning toward a hybrid. deep dives for 2 high-risk bets, lightning reviews for updates. keeps energy up and reduces prep burden.

kevin: agree. eng prefers focused 90-min blocks for infra/product trade-offs. but we need explicit facilitation for timers + parking lot.

clare: noted. can we draft a simple facilitator checklist? i want something short we can hand to ICs.

(tess): putting a design + storytelling lens on the 90-min slots — we should reserve the last 15 for demo/proof-of-concept artifacts.

oliver: ops question — any hard constraints on room set/AV? we have hybrid folks in EMEA, need clear camera + mics for breakout capture.

ajay: good call. propose this trial schedule:
```
09:00 - 09:30 Intro + themes (all)
09:30 - 11:00 Deep-dive A (facilitator + scribe)
11:15 - 12:00 Lightning round 1 (4x 8min + Q)
12:00 - 13:00 Lunch
13:00 - 14:30 Deep-dive B (facilitator + scribe)
14:45 - 15:30 Lightning round 2
15:30 - 16:15 Synthesis + decision owners
16:15 - 17:00 Social / open sync
```

clare: love that. who volunteers as facilitators for deep-dive A/B? (we should avoid PMs who are presenters)

kevin: i can facilitate Deep-dive A if ajay can be backup. i can also prep a 1-page ops brief for infra tradeoffs.

ajay: happy to back up. clare, can you own Deep-dive B facilitation? you know the customer asks best.

clare: i can, but i'd prefer tess to co-facilitate the narrative + demo bit.

(tess): yep, i'll co-facilitate. i'll also build a 1-slide demo template for presenters.

oliver: AV checklist —
- confirm room camera + omnidirectional mic for 2 rooms
- record sessions to drive notes
- ensure VPN rendezvous link for remote folks
- have spare laptop and HDMI adapter at A/V table

planning-bot: Reminder set: facilitator orientation 3 days before event at 10:00. RSVP needed by 5pm this Friday.

clare: next steps: ajay/kevin/tess/oliver — add anything missing to the "facilitator checklist" doc (i'll create and link). deadline EOD tomorrow. i'll compile and send the final flow to execs on Friday. :thumbsup:

ajay: will add timer script + parking-lot template.

kevin: adding infra brief and a short Q template for decision owners.

(tess): will add demo template and a slide layout for results.

clare: thanks team — if we can lock facilitators + checklist by tomorrow we'll be in great shape.
